item.title: 80 Mile delays Greenland drilling and receives regulatory warning
item.summary: 80 Mile has pushed back the planned drilling of its Jameson Land Basin project in East Greenland and said it has received a formal warning from the Greenlandic government over landing equipment without the required permit. This is not the news investors in the AIM-listed explorer wanted to hear.
